Application for Export Financing – Pre-shipment financing on open account basis / Sales Invoice Financing

We enclose herewith the following bill and documents for collection / advance according to the instructions set out below. We agree to be bound by your prevailing General Banking Terms and Conditions, applicable Jurisdiction Schedules and Trade Services Schedule (each as may be amended, supplemented, substituted and/or replaced from time to time). We confirm that we have been given such prevailing terms [or accessed them, where published, at bank.example/trade] and have reviewed them. 
 
We further confirm that we agree to each declaration of trust and trust receipt set out in Clauses 10.5 and 11 of the Trade Services Schedule relating to this Trade Service (if any) or any other Trade Service, and whether such Trade Services are provided to us before, on or after the date of this Form.
